summary: Revenue of $753.2M, 2.891M subscribers and $60.3M adjusted EBITDA beat the true pre-event bars, but the unadjusted and adjusted gross margin collapsed to 64%, free cash flow was -$68.2M, and a $60M FTC accrual weakens earnings quality. With a revenue beat already anticipated, FY revenue guidance centered at $3.2B but EBITDA only at $300M confirms growth is being purchased with materially worse economics, supporting a medium-strength downside repricing.
